# Pyramid Love reference artwork

LightHouse uses Pyramid Love 3.1 as a reference for selected Pyramid Arcade
visuals:

- The Wheel line topology and snap-region layout are transcribed from
  `UsefulSVG/WheelBoard.svg` and rescaled to LightHouse's physical board
  dimensions.
- Dice face symbols and Pyramid Die size/pip conventions are redrawn from the
  supplied Pyramid Love artwork.
- Board-menu marks are compact native-Canvas redrawings of the corresponding
  Pyramid Love component SVGs.

No Pyramid Love font binary is bundled with LightHouse.

Pyramid Love copyright (c) 2016 Lou Lessing. The archive identifies Looney
Labs & Lou Lessing as designers and reserves the font name "Pyramid Love".
The supplied license is the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `OFL.txt`.
